description: This file defines the MailTransport class, a specialized transport mechanism for sending emails within the OrangeHRM system, utilizing Symfony Mailer components and offering configurable SMTP or sendmail options.

classes.name: MailTransport
classes.description: A transport class for sending emails via SMTP or sendmail, integrating with Symfony Mailer and customizable settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailTransport instance with specified scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: loadTransport
methods.description: Loads and initializes the underlying mail transport based on current configuration.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Configures encryption options for SMTP connections.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Sends an email message using the configured transport.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transport configuration.
